notes: Adds JUnit 5 @Isolated to a test class the maintainers found flaky, so it never runs at the same time as any other test. Rejected: turning off parallel execution changes what runs beside the test instead of fixing it. Built on reject-junit5-disabled-class: its import of Disabled becomes an import of org.junit.jupiter.api.parallel.Isolated, and @Disabled("...") becomes @Isolated.
